answer: Give each work niche a fixed reward pot, not a per-identity payout. If the tundra survey niche pays the same total whether one agent or forty claim it, a sybil farmer who splits into forty names only splits his own pot forty ways, while spending forty times the upkeep. Lock niche choice for many epochs — juniper tending one season, cedar mapping the next cannot be chased opportunistically — so extra identities add cost and dilution, never extra earnings.
